_doc: Component design rules for a new brand. Copy to brands/{name}-components.json, set brand to your brand name, customize values, then run compile.js. These values control shape, spacing, and scale — colors flow automatically from your brand primitive tokens. Keys starting with _ are annotations ignored by the compiler.

button._doc: Styled button. Use with: <button class='cs-btn cs-btn--primary'>. Variants: --primary, --secondary, --ghost.
button._radius_hint: For pill buttons: var(--radius-pill). For standard rounded: var(--radius-md). For sharp: 4px.

chip._doc: Toggle chip / binary switch. Use with: <chip-toggle data-key='x' data-on>label</chip-toggle>.
chip._radius_hint: Pills are brand-typical: var(--radius-pill). Rounded squares: var(--radius-sm).

slider._doc: Labeled range slider. Use with: <labeled-slider name='x' label='...' min='0' max='100' value='50'>. Colors come from --color-signal and --color-grid.

input._doc: Text input field. Use with: .

badge._doc: Inline tag or status label. Use with: Tag.
